# Contribute to Text-to-Video Generator

Thank you for your interest in contributing! This project is open to improvements.

## How to Contribute

### 1. Report Issues

- Found a bug? [Create an issue](https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/text-to-video-generator/issues)
- Describe what happened and how to reproduce it

### 2. Suggest Features

- Have an idea? [Start a discussion](https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/text-to-video-generator/discussions)
- Explain what feature you'd like and why it would help

### 3. Submit Code

1. Fork the repository
2. Create a branch: `git checkout -b feature/your-feature-name`
3. Make your changes
4. Test with `python run_all.py`
5. Commit: `git commit -am 'Add your feature'`
6. Push: `git push origin feature/your-feature-name`
7. Open a Pull Request

## Code Style

- Keep code clean and readable
- Add comments for complex logic
- Test your changes before submitting
- Update documentation if needed

## Testing

Before submitting:

```bash
python run_all.py
```

All tests should pass.

## Questions?

Feel free to ask in the Issues or Discussions section!

Thank you! 🎉
